## Evidence
At commit `071133a4c7370ab1f412b25c92ea365844b70ba4`, [release job 124879572560](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-swarm/actions/runs/41308056337/job/124879572560) repeatedly reports `Rebase merges are not allowed on this repository. (HTTP405)`. The release PR [#50](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-swarm/pull/50), head `6039088b6d99a37ff2a5ac3eaa36f63f4338d453`, was still open/CLEAN at 15:41 UTC on November 1; the job reports no settling or failing checks.

The [workflow hardcodes merge_method=rebase](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-swarm/blob/071133a4c7370ab1f412b25c92ea365844b70ba4/.github/workflows/release.yml#L539-L543). After retrying for 30 minutes, its [generic timeout diagnostic](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-swarm/blob/071133a4c7370ab1f412b25c92ea365844b70ba4/.github/workflows/release.yml#L590-L594) attributes failure to missing checks/review rather than the deterministic unsupported merge method.

## Expected, actual and impact
Expected: preserve repository merge policy and branch protection, and either use an already permitted, policy-compliant method or identify the unsupported method promptly.
Actual: deterministic HTTP405 responses are retried as if the PR were still settling, blocking this release-metadata merge and occupying a runner unnecessarily. No claim is made about data loss or whether a package was published through another run.

This conflicts with reliable release-readiness behavior tracked in the existing [pm-swarm-release-gate record](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-swarm/blob/071133a4c7370ab1f412b25c92ea365844b70ba4/.agents/pm/chores/pm-swarm-release-gate.toon). That record is closed and does not cover this method mismatch. All-status issues/PRs and canonical PM records were checked before filing.

## Acceptance and regression criteria
- Preserve existing repository merge policy/protection; do not enable rebase or weaken required checks just to pass.
- Select an already allowed policy-compliant merge method, or fail immediately with a precise unsupported-method diagnostic.
- Do not retry deterministic method-policy rejection as pending checks.
- Cover CLEAN + forbidden method, genuinely pending checks and rejected checks in bounded regression tests.
- Preserve immutable-head/tree/provenance verification before publication and existing coverage requirements.

Classification: hosted-log plus exact static-source finding. No local execution, source modification, merge, repository setting change or deployment was performed.
Release workflow retries forbidden rebase merges for 30 minutes and misclassifies the blocker
